mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entry_link (src_id, dst_id, link_type) VALUES (#{srcId}, #{dstId}, #{linkType}) ON CONFLICT (src_id, dst_id, link_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.type, e.title, e.content_plain, e.source_date, e.pinned, e.updated_at FROM entry_link l JOIN entry e ON e.id = l.dst_id WHERE l.src_id = #{srcId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

SELECT e.id, e.type, e.title, e.content_plain, e.source_date, e.pinned, e.updated_at FROM entry_link l JOIN entry e ON e.id = l.src_id WHERE l.dst_id = #{dstId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
